items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: And that was where Farzola used to go all the time.

ctx.x: Cotton Club. Near the Cotton Club? Yeah, I think that was it, the Cotton Club. Sure, that was it. Not the Blue Horseshoe.

No, no, no. Cotton Club. No, the Cotton Club. Blue Horseshoe. Blue Horseshoe was backed by the... Yeah, that was it, the Cotton Club. Blue Horseshoe used to be backed by the Two Bits Club in the... What's in the... Where you were. And that was where Farzola used to go all the time. In fact, one morning we were playing the theme song, the WWL, and... I don't know whether it's just good to put on or not. He's leaving the... They're just playing the theme and Farz walks out of the studio and Ed Hernan says, where…
You got the right name. Cotton Club, that's it.
